name: Intel Haswell-E / Haswell-EP (X99 / C612)
cpuFamily: Haswell-E / Haswell-EP (Core i7 58xx/59xxX and Xeon E5 v3)
description: X99 / C612 HEDT and dual-socket Xeon E5 v3. No consumer iGPU. XCPM needs the Haswell CPUID spoof. Dell T5810/T7910 BIOS also needs CpuTscSync.kext (OpenCore 1.0.x does not ship ResetTSCAdjust.efi) or Monterey+ panics with non-monotonic time. Use iMacPro1,1 and a discrete GPU.

mandatorySsdt.name: SSDT-PLUG.aml
mandatorySsdt.reason: Native X86PlatformPlugin CPU power management on Haswell and newer.

mandatorySsdt.name: SSDT-EC-USBX.aml
mandatorySsdt.reason: Fake Embedded Controller plus USB power properties (Dortania desktop).

mandatorySsdt.name: SSDT-EC.aml
mandatorySsdt.reason: Separate fake EC used by the known-working Dell T5810/T7910 EFI.

mandatorySsdt.name: SSDT-HPET.aml
mandatorySsdt.reason: IRQ conflict fix (HPET) from the known-working Dell X99 ACPI set.

mandatorySsdt.name: SSDT-SBUS-MCHC.aml
mandatorySsdt.reason: Adds SMBus / MCHC so AppleSMBus attaches on X99.

mandatorySsdt.name: SSDT-RTC0-RANGE.aml
mandatorySsdt.reason: Required for Big Sur and newer so the X99/C612 RTC range is compatible.

mandatorySsdt.name: SSDT-UNC.aml
mandatorySsdt.reason: Required for Big Sur and newer so uncore PCI bridges enumerate instead of stalling boot.

bootNotes: CpuTscSync.kext is required on Dell T5810/T7910. OpenCore 1.0.x does not ship ResetTSCAdjust.efi, so listing that driver would halt boot. CpuTscSync resets IA32_TSC_ADJUST on Monterey and newer (non-monotonic time panic) and again after sleep.
UEFI TscSyncTimeout is also set so cores sync before the kernel starts.
OpenCore text picker: Reset NVRAM is listed because HideAuxiliary is off. If you do not see it, press Spacebar, then choose Reset NVRAM; the machine reboots.
After Reset NVRAM, boot the Sequoia installer again.
Sequoia install on this Dell X99: SecureBootModel = Disabled (not Default), ReleaseUsbOwnership = False, EnableVectorAcceleration = False. Leave BIOS alone; change the EFI.
cpus=1 is only a diagnostic. The profile default does not include it — add it from the boot-args chips if you need a single-core test, then remove it.

T7910 is dual-socket; do not keep T5810-generated EC/HPET/PLUG/RTC0-RANGE. On Kexts → ACPI SSDTs, load the .aml files (or zip) from SSDTTime on this machine, or T7910_ACPI_via_Clover.zip. Your files override the downloaded T5810 copies. Do not inject DSDT.aml or OEM SSDT-0/1 tables.
Do not enable SSDT-X99-USBX.aml with the T7910 SSDTs. It calls DTGP from the old T5810 SBUS table and panics with AE_NOT_FOUND. SSDT-EC-USBX already provides USB power properties.

igpu.name: None
igpu.warning: Haswell-E / Xeon E5 v3 has no consumer iGPU. Choose a supported AMD dGPU.
